description:
Refresh the user-facing Wheel manual page for the merged 0.1.0 runtime surface.

## Scope

Update `bitty-manual/en/plugins/catalog/wheel.md` and `bitty-manual/zh-CN/plugins/catalog/wheel.md` (and catalog/index links if needed) so they accurately describe:

- Wheel 0.1.0 as a standalone Lua library/agent-harness artifact (`just package`/`just install-local`, `LUA_PATH`), distinct from the still-scaffold `bitty-plugin.toml` 0.0.1 plugin entry.
- The actual plugin command surface (14 commands) and `platform.notify` capability; do not imply provider/agent integration that is not shipped.
- The experimental local session daemon: `scripts/wheel-session` start/stop/status/snapshot/list/put/get/probe, private FIFOs, same-user local-only residual, no multi-user auth.
- The offline benchmark suite (`just bench`, `bench-json`, `bench-release-smoke`; results are regression signals, not budgets).
- Versioned `WheelContext` snapshot/restore (`CONTEXT-SNAPSHOT.md`; not authenticated; excludes stash/subscribers/config).
- Current limitations: no published tag/artifact, no CLI/launcher, no Bitty host integration, no live provider config loader; point to Wheel README/SECURITY-MODEL for detail.

## Requirements

- Follow the manual's page spine and language policy: English canonical, zh-CN translation, code/API names untranslated.
- Do not invent commands, flags, API signatures, or configuration fields; verify against the Wheel repository at `05f405a` (or current main).
- Docs-only Markdown changes; no code, manifest schema, or plugin behavior changes.
- Run the manual's docs gates (`just check`/`package`; known ignored `recording/` lint noise can be noted) and report exact evidence.
- No push/PR/merge by the implementer; commander opens the docs PR and merges per docs-only policy.
title: Refresh Wheel manual page for 0.1.0 runtime surface
